about: Errata to Rev3.0_GlassFront_Frame_report.json and Rev3.0_GlassFront_Assembly_report.json (GF-2.0, Fusion document version 18): statements corrected by the independent verification 2026-11-16 (tools/glassfront/verify). The reports themselves are not edited.
params_change: change_log.post_verification_corrections_2026-11-16 (notes, criteria, check results; logo-zone centre; no frame-driving value changed); then change_log.post_verification_addendum_2026-11-16

items.report_value: GF-2.0: the tail-pocket corners at the shelf end (bend-gap slot front face x side walls, y 119.1) as GF-1.1
items.verified: the two inside corners shelf end (y 119.0) x tail-pocket side walls (x 38.9 / 167.7) carry R0.5 vertical rounds between Z_SEAT and Z_SHELF_BACK in the GF-2.0 STEP (GF-1.1: sharp); 0.29 mm3; now listed in cad_rules

items.report_value: the bend-gap slot is the only through-opening at the bottom: 3.0 x 128.8; A (recess core) / B (tail-pocket core) shut-off on its outline at Z_LAND; along the bridge edge the 0.3 break moves the shut-off line 0.3 up the slot face (formed by the A core)
items.verified: parting on the bridge side at the break top (y 122.005, Z -10.12) and on the front side at the shelf corner (y 119.00, Z -4.60): the shut-off rises 5.52 over 3.00; buildable as an A ledge 3.0 x 0.3 plus a telescopic face along y 119.0 (>= 3 deg), steel B 91 / A 135 deg; see cad_rules

items.note: 0.0 is the overlap of the tail end with the J10 / J11 models (1.215 / 1.948 mm3), a model artefact that also exists at GF-1.1 with the DS1 model's own tail bodies ({'tft_tail_5': 0.822, 'tft_fingers_6': 2.112} / {'ctp_tail_7': 1.9145, 'ctp_fingers_8': 1.5285} mm3)

the overall minima agree (TFT 1.524, CTP 0.946, both to the R1.5 nose). The grouping differs: the report's 'bridge pocket face / land break' value is measured to the break top edge (y 122.005, Z -10.12), i.e. the break alone - the flat pocket face is closer (TFT 1.851, CTP 1.055); its 'flange plate (pocket floor)' TFT 5.17 is measured to pip P4 on the land (Z -10.42), the flange plate itself is 4.67; its 'bridge floor (land-plate back)' 2.671 / 2.672 equals the step face y 130.89 here, the land-plate back is 2.385 / 2.219. Under the GF-2.0 criteria (tail_clearance_criteria) every class outside the bend zone is >= 1.5 nominal
envelope dia 5.8 x 1.4 with the shank at the slot limits (7 positions per stud): the extreme is at F3, end + across (floor round), not at F1 along; all > 0, no overlap
